title: Spectacular Afternoon Sail on San Diego Bay
includes: Two hour Afternoon Sail on San Diego Bay
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
A unique two-hour sailing Experience aboard our 35-foot sailboat, Luna. Limited to six people. Watch for playful dolphins, sea lions, and pelicans. Get hands-on or sit back and enjoy breathtaking views of the city's skyline and waterfront attractions as we sail among tall ships, mega-yachts, and military vessels and your local Captain shares his knowledge of sailing and San Diego.

We invite you to celebrate a special occasion with your partner, family or group and capture the moments in breathtaking photos. 

No sailing experience is needed for this family-friendly outing, but participation is welcome. We love sharing our knowledge and experience.

Choose a public or private tour option when you book.

Snacks and bottled water included. Feel free to bring your own easy to handle alcoholic/non-alcoholic beverages and snacks.

Free cancellation, 100% refund up to 24 hours before your reservation.
